data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions: Gross provisions (59,134), Reinsurance assets 23,440, Net (35,694)
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross favourable prior year development of $59.134 million, representing an 8.001% release of opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable movement is primarily attributed to favourable claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of $35.7m (2023: $27.6m favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development by line of business is not available; only net breakdown is provided. The gross claims development triangle (Note 16) shows a different prior year development figure than the explicit 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' table (Note 16, page 22), which is used as the primary source. Technical provision balances relating to the 2020 and prior years of account were transferred through Reinsurance to Close to Syndicate 2008 on 1 January 2023.
